description: Upgrade Copilot for a Canton validator: given the Splice version a node runs and its network, report whether it is below the minimum in force, how many releases behind, the next topology freeze and LSU (with UTC time), the minimum .dar package versions, and the breaking changes between the running version and the target. Canton-specific. Use when an operator asks "am I safe to skip this week?", "what breaks if I upgrade?", or "when is my next deadline?".

environment.description: Which network the node runs on.

version.description: Splice version the node currently runs, e.g. "0.6.9". Omit to get the schedule without a verdict.

name: get_upgrade_status
